name: Codex任务定位
summary: 按明确项目路径及名称只读查本机会话候选，再由平台核身份。
summaryEn: Find local session candidates by explicit project and name; verify identity through the host.
requirements: Node.js、Python 3及已获准访问的本地Codex元数据库。
查询只返回检查点候选，不能代替平台核验。
requirementsEn: Node.js, Python 3 and an authorized local Codex metadata database.
Lookup returns checkpoint candidates only; host verification is still required.
instructions: 在本包根目录按README执行 node .github/scripts/Find-CodexThread.mjs，并填写已授权项目根与名称。
0.1.0是初始独立分发版本，不代表修改了定位功能。
instructionsEn: From this package root, follow the README to run node .github/scripts/Find-CodexThread.mjs with the authorized project root and name.
0.1.0 is the initial distribution version, not a change to lookup behavior.
